tasks.subject: Task 1: Reframe Stage A prompt to PackML vocabulary
tasks.description:
**Goal:** buildEmStateMachineInterviewPrompt/OpeningMessage author using the fixed PackML slugs (from PACKML_STATES), model manual motions as Execute-phase behaviour (not states), mark aborted as the single safe state.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/lib/spec-builder/em-state-machine-prompts.ts
- Test: src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/em-state-machine-prompts.test.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- PACKML STATE VOCABULARY section from PACKML_STATES (stopped/idle/execute/aborting/aborted present)
- safe state must be aborted; state_id must be a PackML slug
- MANUAL / COMMAND-DRIVEN MOTIONS ARE NOT STATES section defers motions to Stage B
- old free-slug tokens driving_fwd/auto_cycle/faulted absent
- opening references PackML + aborted, not 'manually driving'
- existing prompt tests still pass

**Verify:** npx vitest run src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/em-state-machine-prompts.test.ts && npx tsc -b

tasks.subject: Task 2: Compose + wire PackML conformance gate into Stage A persist
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add pure validateEmStateMachineAndPackml(em) (structural then PackML conformance) and call it from handleStateMachineResponse so non-PackML / non-aborted-safe Stage A proposals are blocked, not persisted.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/lib/spec-builder/em-state-machine.ts (add helper; leave validateEmStateMachine + validateEmPackmlConformance untouched)
- Test: src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/em-state-machine.test.ts
- Modify: src/hooks/use-fds-conversation.ts (handleStateMachineResponse + import)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- helper returns [] for defaultEmStates() machine and empty skeleton
- surfaces driving_fwd as conformance issue
- structural issues ordered before conformance issues
- handleStateMachineResponse calls composed helper (not validateEmStateMachine); non-PackML proposal -> failure turn, no persist
- both component validators still exported + independently tested
- Stage-A-only wiring: validateSpecContractPatch untouched

**Verify:** npx tsc -b && npx vitest run src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/em-state-machine.test.ts src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/em-state-machine-prompts.test.ts
